description: Retime a local SRT/VTT file after ripple edits; Premiere captions do not follow ripple_remove_timeline_ranges or insert_from_source. Operations: shift, ripple_remove_ranges, ripple_insert, edit_cue. Keeps VTT header/NOTE/STYLE, cue settings, karaoke stamps; renumbers SRT. Local-only, never changes Premiere: re-import via create_caption_track, then reapply styling (get_caption_style_guidance).

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute existing directory that must contain input_path and output_path. Required when either path is given.

at_seconds.description: ripple_insert: timeline time of the insert; cues starting at or after it move right.

content.description: Inline SRT or VTT text. Provide exactly one of input_path or content. A UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings are accepted.

cue_index.description: edit_cue: 1-based cue position in file order (SRT numbers are ignored).

duration_frames.description: ripple_insert: inserted duration in whole frames at fps.

duration_seconds.description: ripple_insert: inserted duration in seconds. Use exactly one of duration_seconds or duration_frames.

end_seconds.description: edit_cue: new cue end in seconds; must be after the start.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

fps.description: Optional sequence frame rate (e.g. 23.976, 25, 29.97). When set, every output time and every removal range snaps to the nearest frame, matching ripple_remove_timeline_ranges; otherwise times round to milliseconds. Required for offset_frames and duration_frames.

from_seconds.description: shift: only shift cues whose start is at or after this time; earlier cues stay put.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-chosen key (1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) for this intended edit. Pass a fresh key per edit and reuse it only when retrying that same edit, for example after a client-side timeout. A repeat with the same tool, key and arguments is not run again: while the first call is running it fails with IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS (poll get_last_operations); after it finished it returns the original outcome marked replayed. A definite failure with nothing applied (receipt outcome not_applied) may be retried with the same key. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Scoped to this MCP session (the stdio server process or one HTTP session) and held in memory only (200 keys, 1 hour); it does not survive a restart or reconnect. Read-only invocations are never deduplicated.

input_format.description: Syntax of the input. Defaults to the input_path extension, else VTT when content starts with WEBVTT, else SRT.

input_path.description: Absolute path of an existing .srt or .vtt file inside approved_workspace_path (realpath-checked, at most 2097152 bytes). Provide exactly one of input_path or content.

offset_frames.description: shift: whole frames to add at fps (negative moves earlier).

offset_seconds.description: shift: seconds to add (negative moves earlier). Cues ending at or before 0 are removed; cues crossing 0 are trimmed. Use exactly one of offset_seconds or offset_frames.

output_format.description: Format of the result (default: the output_path extension, else the input format). SRT output drops VTT header/NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks, cue settings, identifiers, and karaoke timestamps, with warnings.

output_path.description: Optional absolute .srt/.vtt path to write the result to. Requires approved_workspace_path; the parent must exist inside it and the file must not already exist (never overwritten).

ranges.description: ripple_remove_ranges: removed timeline ranges in seconds, sorted and non-overlapping (the same ranges passed to ripple_remove_timeline_ranges; overlapping ranges are rejected, not merged).

end.description: Range end in seconds; must be greater than start.

return_content.description: Also return the retimed text inline when output_path is set (default false). Inline text is always returned without output_path, up to 512 KiB.

start_seconds.description: edit_cue: new cue start in seconds.

straddle_policy.description: ripple_insert: a cue spanning at_seconds is split into two cues around the gap (split, default) or stretched across it (extend).

text.description: edit_cue: replacement cue text; separate lines with a newline. Blank lines and "-->" are rejected.

name: retime_caption_file

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

idempotency.description: Present when idempotency_key deduplicated this call: replayed is true when the original outcome was returned instead of running again.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.
